name: SCROLLS
description: SCROLLS (Standardized CompaRison Over Long Language Sequences) is a benchmark for evaluating language models on long document understanding tasks. It standardizes seven diverse NLP tasks requiring processing of long texts (thousands of tokens) including summarization, question answering, and natural language inference over long documents.
reputation: Standard benchmark for long-context language modeling; introduced at EMNLP 2022; widely used to evaluate long-context LLMs and efficient transformers
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2022. Seven tasks: GovReport, SumScr, QMSum, QASPER, NarrativeQA, QuALITY, ContractNLI. Unified input format with task prefix. Standardized evaluation enables fair comparison. Updated to SCROLLS+ with additional tasks. Documents range from thousands to tens of thousands of tokens. Critical for evaluating long-context models.
